1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Align one generated horizontal socket with a broad opening; deliberate aim builds charge.
1.natural_language: Explore the reliquary, assemble the ward key, then align its tips with every generated socket until the door releases. Deliberate aim controls settle the key and build charge; the stable socket layout does not change while you wait. Then click the open door to leave. Early certification or exhausting the visible 90-second action spring ends the attempt. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
